newsitem.title: INDIA: India's LML surges nine pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India's LML surges nine pct on results.

text.p: Shares of two wheeler maker LML Ltd jumped 4.50 rupees, or nine percent, to 51.50 on the Bombay bourse on Wednesday after the firm announced improved results for the six months ended March 31, traders said.
LML said late on Tuesday its net surged 111 percent to 172 million rupees in the six months to March 31, from 81.6 million in the previous year.
The company said its scooter sales climbed to 142,703 units, from 123,458 in the six months ended March 31, 1996.
"They've definitely bucked the trend as far as the industry is concerned," said an automobiles analyst refering to a slowdown in demand that has hit two-wheeler makers.
Analysts said latest data for April sales showed a rise of five percent for LML against an average 16 percent fall for the segment.
